blocks.text: This documentation (the “”The Issue of International Security”) will highlight all the information about the newly improved agency: the Continental Security Agency. This documentation has been written by the approval of the Director of the Agency (the Director of Security/Chief of Security/Secretary of Security “Universal Federal Higher Major General Enzo Hernandez, MD, PhD). This documentation was written by the Director’s Office, with collaboration with the Higher Federal Office of the Republic of the Maldives and the United States of America. All the collaborative indexes (the “Indexes”) are as follows:

items.text: The United States of America/The Great Seal of America

blocks.text: Before furthermore proceeding with this issue, the Universal Declaration of Federal Law for Agencies, Article of International Affairs, Section 3, Paragraph 2, we (the “Department of Foreign Affairs, Continental Security Agency from the Director’s Office”) execute as follows:

items.text: Once all parties involved in representing the seal have signed this document, the seals, emblems, or indexes should be closed. Any documentation including the seals, emblems, or indexes before the signature of the representation should be deemed legally and officially as plagiarism, a fake and a breach of the Article of the International Affairs.
We hereby declare a pause to the publishing of the documentation, unless signed right away.

blocks.text: The chain of command will not act in any official, office capacity but will act under the Command Act for Armed Forces. The Command Act for Armed Forces (CAAF), section 4 of Command Bodies or Chain of Commands states that the chain of command of any Armed Forces should act under the forces and not any official capacity. The team that should act under any official capacity should and will only be the Board or the Cabinet of a certain Armed Forces Agency (AFA). In-light of this, in this issue we officialise that the Chain of Command as above will only act in the Armed Forces training grounds or other grounds.
